Using Arie

The next time
you reach for an app.

  1. 01

    Bring up Arie.

    Open Arie to speak or type, or share text and images to it. On Android, set Arie as your default assistant to use your phone’s assistant gesture.

  2. 02

    Say what you need done.

    “Add a dentist appointment tomorrow at 3.” Include the details, or share them with Arie.

  3. 03

    See what actually happened.

    Arie tells you what’s done, what opened in another app and what still needs your help.
